column1: # The sun-sanity pass's open findings (tools/timetables sunSanity; SunSanity.kt): starts the engine shows on the wrong
# side of the real sun at app cities, unit points or Settings choices at app cities, which nothing in the day excuses.
# None is open. The thirteen listed here until 12 Nov 2026 (a Dhuhr up to 65 s before the real transit, or a Maghrib up
# to 22 s before the real sunset, at be.emb, bh.council, ca.mac, eg.esa, ie.icci, nz.fianz, ps.gaza.awqaf,
# ps.gaza.cautious, ps.iftaa and za.mjc: an authority's whole-minute figure, printed for one point of a city, sitting a
# few seconds before the sun at another) are closed by the owner's ruling of 12 Nov 2026 and ruling R180: the real sun
# at the user's own point is the floor of Dhuhr and of Maghrib in the engine itself (DayPipeline.onRealSun), so neither
# can be shown before it at any place, under any entry or Settings choice. The pass still checks both on every run,
# outside the pipeline and with the same sun model as the floor (the engine's exact one, good to a few seconds; it has
# no guard seconds), and a Dhuhr before transit or a Maghrib before sunset now fails it outright, found or listed:
# neither may be given a ceiling here again. What the floor moved is in the pass's report (place-days and worst minutes
# A finding of another check (a Fajr or an end of eating after the real sunrise, an Isha at or before Maghrib, with no
# excuse in the day) would be listed below with its ceilings: worst_s, the worst seconds found rounded up plus one
# second for the window's drift from year to year, and points, the number of points found; the pass fails on a
# finding not listed, worse than worst_s, or at more points. A listed finding is a debt, with its fix in the note.
